title: IIT Delhi Data Science, AI Certificate Programme 2026: Applications Open For Fourth Batch; Check Eligibility, Curriculum
description: IIT Delhi has opened applications for the fourth batch of its eight-month online Certificate Programme in Applied Data Science and Artificial Intelligence. Graduates and diploma holders meeting the eligibility criteria can apply until November 13, 2026.
